```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2); library(forcats); library(knitr)

main_file <- here::here("5_outputs", "insect_trade_main_DRAFT.xlsx")
sale_file <- here::here("5_outputs", "tables", "species_on_sale.xlsx")
main  <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(main_file, sheet = "main")
web   <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(main_file, sheet = "web_listings")
shops <- if (file.exists(sale_file)) openxlsx::read.xlsx(sale_file, sheet = "shops") else tibble()
acc   <- read_csv(here::here("2_processed_data", "species_accepted_state.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
n_crawled <- sum(shops$status %in% c("ok", "ok (time limit)"))
fmt <- \(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
lvl <- \(x) as.integer(substr(x, 1, 1))
ev_levels <- c("1 live on sale online now", "2 live US imports (LEMIS)",
               "3 live use (literature)", "4 traded, form unknown", "5 dead material only")
TIERS <- c("Regulated here", "Regulated elsewhere", "Potential plant pest", "No known plant risk")
main <- main |> mutate(tier = factor(tier, TIERS),
                       live_evidence_level = factor(live_evidence_level, ev_levels),
                       live = lvl(live_evidence_level) <= 3)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "bottom"))
```

## The question

**Which invertebrates that are traded alive — online or as imports — are known or potential plant pests for Norway?**

- Live insects, mites, snails and slugs are sold online as pets, feeders, biocontrol agents and for breeding.
- Dead specimens (pinned, framed, collections) carry no plant-pest risk: we follow **live** trade only.
- Scope: **plant pests only** (insects, mites, land and apple snails, slugs, nematodes). Crustaceans, spiders, scorpions and marine molluscs are out, even when they are invasive species.

## How we did it

| Step | What | Source |
|----|----|----|
| 1 | Traded species list | Hughes et al. 2026 (*Sci. Adv.*): 10,682 invertebrate names |
| 2 | Live imports | LEMIS US imports 2000–2022, corrected (Marshall et al. 2025) |
| 3 | Live use in trade | Lassaline et al. 2025 review; Wang et al. 2023 eBay sales |
| 4 | Names | GBIF backbone, Catalogue of Life, EPPO codes (synonyms merged) |
| 5 | Pest status | EPPO Global Database: EPPO/EU/national lists, host plants |
| 6 | **On sale now** | **Own web scrape**: `r fmt(n_crawled)` shops crawled so far (catalogues, product pages, shipping terms) |
| 7 | Draft tier | Regulated here · Regulated elsewhere · Potential plant pest · No known plant risk |

## From traded species to live plant-pest candidates

```{r}
#| label: funnel
funnel <- tibble(
  step = c("Species screened", "In plant-pest scope", "Live evidence (any source)",
           "Known or potential plant pest with live evidence",
           "Regulated here with live evidence", "On sale online now (web scrape)"),
  n = c(nrow(acc), nrow(main), sum(main$live),
        sum(main$tier != "No known plant risk" & main$live),
        sum(main$tier == "Regulated here" & main$live), sum(main$on_sale_online))) |>
  mutate(step = fct_rev(fct_inorder(step)))
ggplot(funnel, aes(n, step, fill = step)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt(n)), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = NULL)
```

## Most traded insects are dead specimens

```{r}
#| label: live-dead
main |>
  mutate(group = fct_lump_n(pest_group, 4)) |>
  ggplot(aes(fct_infreq(group), fill = fct_rev(live_evidence_level))) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.95, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Species") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, reverse = TRUE))
```

`r fmt(sum(lvl(main$live_evidence_level) == 5 & main$pest_group == "insect"))` of `r fmt(sum(main$pest_group == "insect"))` insect species are known only as dead material (collections, eBay specimens, LEMIS bodies).

## Plant-pest status and live-trade evidence

```{r}
#| label: tier-evidence
ggplot(main, aes(tier, fill = live_evidence_level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", direction = -1, end = 0.95, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Species") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

::: callout-warning
"Potential plant pest" (`r fmt(sum(main$tier == "Potential plant pest"))` species) uses a rough plant-feeding proxy (family/order).
It needs host-plant data before it can rank species.
:::

## Regulated here: what evidence of live trade?

```{r}
#| label: regulated-grid
#| fig-height: 7.5
reg <- main |> filter(tier == "Regulated here") |>
  transmute(species,
            `Online now (shops)` = web_shops,
            `LEMIS live imports` = lemis_live_shipments,
            `Live use (literature)` = as.integer(str_detect(coalesce(lassaline_use, ""),
                                                            "pet|biocontrol|exhibit|pollin|honey|aquarium|feeder")),
            `Dead material only` = as.integer(lvl(live_evidence_level) == 5)) |>
  pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "evidence", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(present = n > 0,
         evidence = factor(evidence, c("Online now (shops)", "LEMIS live imports",
                                       "Live use (literature)", "Dead material only")))
ggplot(reg, aes(evidence, fct_rev(species), fill = present)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0 & evidence %in% c("Online now (shops)", "LEMIS live imports"), n, "")),
            colour = "white", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey92", `TRUE` = viridisLite::viridis(1, begin = 0.25)),
                    labels = c(`FALSE` = "no", `TRUE` = "yes"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 11), legend.position = "right")
```

## Regulated pests traded alive

All live trade counts the same, whatever the route (pet, hobby, lab or rearing supply): a live animal is a live animal.

```{r}
#| label: pathways
main |>
  filter(tier == "Regulated here", live) |>
  mutate(pathway = case_when(
           lemis_live_shipments > 0 & str_detect(coalesce(lemis_live_purpose, ""), "S|M") ~ "Lab / rearing",
           str_detect(coalesce(lassaline_use, ""), "pet|aquarium") | web_shops > 0 ~ "Pet / hobby trade",
           TRUE ~ "Other / commercial"),
         lists = str_squish(paste(coalesce(eppo_list, ""), coalesce(eu_list, ""),
                                  ifelse(is.na(no_list), "", paste("NO:", no_list)))),
         evidence = case_when(web_shops > 0 ~ sprintf("online: %d shop(s)", web_shops),
                              lemis_live_shipments > 0 ~ sprintf("LEMIS: %d live shipments %s–%s (purpose %s)",
                                                                 lemis_live_shipments, lemis_live_first, lemis_live_last,
                                                                 lemis_live_purpose),
                              TRUE ~ paste("literature:", lassaline_use))) |>
  arrange(pathway, species) |>
  transmute(Route = pathway, Species = paste0("*", species, "*"), Lists = str_trunc(lists, 70),
            Evidence = evidence) |>
  kable()
```

## On sale online now: most widely offered species

```{r}
#| label: top-online
#| fig-height: 6.5
main |> filter(on_sale_online) |>
  slice_max(web_shops, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(web_shops, fct_reorder(species, web_shops), fill = tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Shops with a product or category page", y = NULL, fill = "Tier") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))
```

Mostly live feeders (mealworm, dubia roach, black soldier fly, superworm, silkworm, waxworm) and pet snails.
Crawl in progress: `r fmt(n_crawled)` shops so far.

## Plant-pest candidates on sale online (not regulated in Norway/EU)

```{r}
#| label: notable-online
main |>
  filter(on_sale_online, tier %in% c("Regulated elsewhere", "Potential plant pest"), plant_feeding == "yes (EPPO host records)" | tier == "Regulated elsewhere") |>
  arrange(tier, desc(web_shops)) |>
  head(15) |>
  transmute(Species = paste0("*", species, "*"), Tier = tier, Shops = web_shops,
            `Live listings` = web_live_listings,
            `Ship to NO` = web_shops_ship_norway,
            `EPPO hosts` = n_hosts,
            `Listed in (countries)` = n_countries_categorized) |>
  kable()
```

## Shops: where are they, and do they ship to Norway?

```{r}
#| label: shops-norway
if (nrow(shops)) {
  shops |> filter(status %in% c("ok", "ok (time limit)")) |>
    mutate(ships = fct_infreq(coalesce(ships_to_norway, "unclear")),
           seller = fct_lump_n(coalesce(na_if(seller_country, ""), "unknown"), 10)) |>
    ggplot(aes(fct_infreq(seller), fill = ships)) +
    geom_bar() +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9, name = "Ships to Norway?") +
    labs(x = "Seller country (best guess)", y = "Shops")
}
```

Shipping terms are often vague: "unclear" means the shop's shipping pages don't name Norway either way.

## What the web scrape does — and does not — cover

- **Covers:** `r fmt(n_crawled)` shops found by multilingual searches (Norwegian/Nordic first); full catalogues where shops publish them (Shopify, WooCommerce), otherwise product sitemaps or links; names matched by scientific names, synonyms and common names in 11 languages.
- **Polite and lawful:** robots.txt obeyed, ≥ 1.5 s between requests per shop, no personal data stored.
- **Not covered:** marketplaces whose terms forbid scraping (eBay, Amazon, Facebook groups, Blocket, DBA …) and shops that show products only with JavaScript.
- **Evidence grades:** a listing counts as *on sale* only if it is a priced product page in a live-animal shop with the species named in the title (strong = labelled live, probable = label unknown). Names only in descriptions (often the target pest of a biocontrol or pesticide product), accessories, research, agrochemical, lab-supply and specimen sites are excluded; a hand-checked list of shop types is in `3_metadata/shop_type_overrides.csv`.
- **Uncertain:** common-name matches (weaker than scientific names), live/dead labels from listing text, shipping terms.

## Limitations

- LEMIS covers **US imports** only; Lassaline and Wang describe past trade, not current sales to Norway.
- EPPO matching is exact; names unknown to EPPO have no regulatory data.
- "Potential plant pest" is a rough proxy until host plants are added.
- Web results are a snapshot (crawl still running) and need manual checks of key listings.

## For discussion with the panel

1.  **Tier rules:** is "Regulated here / Regulated elsewhere / Potential plant pest / No known plant risk" the right frame? (All live trade counts equally: pet, hobby, lab and rearing.)
2.  **Priorities:** which species with live trade should go to a pest risk assessment (e.g. FinnPRIO)? First batch: "Regulated here" and "Regulated elsewhere" with live evidence.
3.  **Routes:** pet and aquarium trade (ants, apple snails) and lab/rearing supply (*Spodoptera*, *Helicoverpa*) both move live pests.
4.  **Gaps:** host plants and climate match for Norway; species names only found by common name.
